title: PaymentFailed
description: Emitted by the payment gateway when a payment attempt fails. This is the primary input event for Salvage. Every field is immutable once published; the event is a fact about what happened, not a request.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier. Used for consumer-side deduplication.

event_version.description: Schema version. Always 1 for this schema.

event_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the failure was observed by the provider. UTC.

merchant_id.description: The tenant identifier. Every downstream query is scoped by this.

order_id.description: The merchant's order identifier. Multiple payment_attempts may exist for one order.

payment_attempt_id.description: The unique attempt within this order. Immutable once written. Maps 1:1 to a provider-side payment ID.

amount_paise.description: Transaction amount in the smallest currency unit (paise for INR). Never zero; a zero-value payment cannot fail.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. INR for the initial deployment.

provider.description: The payment gateway or aggregator. e.g. 'razorpay'.

provider_error_code.description: The raw error code returned by the provider. This is the input to the failure taxonomy normaliser in Phase 3.

provider_error_description.description: Human-readable error description from the provider. Used for LLM narration in Phase 6, never for decision logic.

issuer.description: The issuing bank or instrument provider. Combined with payment_method and provider, this forms the 'rail' — the unit of health monitoring.

customer_id.description: Opaque customer identifier within the merchant's namespace. Null for guest checkouts. Used for contact budgets, opt-out checks, and per-customer locking.

customer_phone_hash.description: SHA-256 of the customer's phone number, hex-encoded. The raw number never enters Salvage. Used for contact deduplication across orders.

customer_email_hash.description: SHA-256 of the customer's email address, hex-encoded.

is_recurring.description: True if this is a mandate/subscription/auto-debit attempt.

mandate_id.description: Provider-side mandate identifier, if is_recurring is true.

upi_app.description: UPI app used (e.g. 'gpay', 'phonepe', 'paytm'), if payment_method is 'upi'. Null if unknown or not UPI.

metadata.description: Merchant-supplied key-value pairs. Passed through opaquely; never used in decision logic.
